title: Compose signed record phases with the selected tensor action in Lean
body:
PR2378 leaves its signed Boolean phase-word proof separate from its selected full-array tensor theorem. This composes those results for every Gaussian coefficient field, with exact width and phase-specific headroom premises, common grid scaling, and inverse phasing at the recovered address. Completed physical address primitives and Python/tape-to-model correspondence remain explicit.

The new `research/lean-record-phase-bridge` package retains PR2378 at `5816f94741709e8082e06a2cc9a114ff87411f3d` and its PR2250/2341 sources unchanged, with source paths, Git blobs, hashes and notices. PR2378 already has packed multi-field finite checks; the new contribution is the quantified formal composition. Its 15 new theorem roots are added to 31 retained axiom probes. No selected frontier or exponent changes.

Validation:

- Fresh Lean 4.33.0-rc1 build: 46 actual axiom probes, standard axioms only; three false proofs rejected for mathematical reasons.
- Actual retained interpreter: 33,280 signed phase cases and three full 4,096-record arrays, with 1/3/5 fields per record, plus six semantic controls. A later-field overflow demonstrates why byte restoration does not imply signed correctness.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay and nine package control groups pass. A Git-free, read-only 38-file execution export passes a fresh kernel build and all controls under CPython 3.14 with an identical kernel receipt and unchanged files.
- Dedicated workflow executes Lean; the generic Python replay explicitly reports that it does not.

Credit: AAAmirinu with Codex for PR2378; Jose Manuel with Codex for PR2250; Gareth Davidson for PR2341; DreamingOfClouds and retained Lemma G contributors. New work by Gareth Davidson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2417
Next steps are a completed physical ADD endpoint and a caller precision-ledger binding. Full hosting, scratch/time accounting and outer multiplication remain open boundaries.
